item.title: Deserves more +1s
item.content:encoded:
+1 from Me, really got my soft spot for Meta fiction. I enjoy the alternative to Swann's proposal, but I also like that they aren't necessarily mutually exclusive. Its also not as, well, grim as the other one, and honestly feels more representative of the actual tone of many of non-mainlist articles. Also, good enough that it kept me reading instead of working on my term paper due in less than 24 hours

I think I have a GoI or tale in mind to use this in

item.title: BEST-001
item.content:encoded: My fave 001, and the one I like most as being the "true" 001, inspired me to write SCP that are more weird or wholesome as opposed to being scary, which i can do. As a furry roleplayer I am an expert on weird shit that is weirdly wholesome sometimes, lol. Needless to say, S&C Plastics and this 001 actually made me sure I can ahve a palce here on the site. SO I made ana ccount. Let's just hope I can find a cure for writer's block. Where's a real life anomalous object with useful effects when ya need one, right? Well, +1 to this

item.title: (no title)
item.content:encoded:
I loved reading this and have nothing negative to say about it.

Except that it's not actually an SCP write-up, is it? It's more the tale of how a write-up came to be.
The only segment that really fits here, in the 001 slot of the in-universe database, is the last draft that Verhoten reads.

Maybe present just that here and [NOT FINISHED] could link to the actual tale?

Said it before, I'm picky and unreasonable when it comes to 001s. But I think I'd have this same quibble for any slot on the mainlist.

item.title: (no title)

I've already told you how much I love this, but I just read it again with your reccomended mood music, and… christ. Something about casually discussing the single most important revelation in the universe and that song… God, I dunno. It hit me.

It almost strikes me as a finale, honestly. If there was ever a "last" skip, I'd want it to be this.

"Well, even if we aren't fictional, we still operate on the rules of it, so same difference." Bailey took out his phone and leaned against the wall.

Could that be a fourth wall? I think so. Incredibly original and clever anomaly and formatting. Perfectly calibrated balance between meta and in-universe. Nice to peek into your mind as an editor too. thanks.

item.content:encoded:
This is excellent. The characters are great, it's got the right about of humour, the entire thing makes sense, nothing overstays its welcome. It paints a nice picture of the more casual side of the Foundation, friendly rivalries between sites, the idea that they would live-stream events like this to other sites, that sort of thing. Lots of awesome little touches. I like the acknowledgement of the existence of other 001s too.
Well earned +1 from me!

item.title: (no title)
item.content:encoded:
After your last anime skip, seeing one with a special object class, I'm half-certain you were just going down my list of pet peeves :P

In seriousness, though, I've often said, both to you and others, that you're my favorite character writer on the wiki, and this is what I'm going to point to when folks ask why. Sloth's Pit has some of the best character development on the site (no small feat), and the feeling of both culmination here, along with the casualness (both perhaps not accurate words, I trust you can understand what I mean) compared to many of the recent 001s (I am getting kind of sick of hyperdramatic world-enders, myself) makes this a standout piece and one more than worthy of a +1.

I do wish there was a bit more conflict or higher stakes, but that's a minor complaint. Nice job :)

item.title: (no title)
item.content:encoded:
About time Sloth Spit was a skip. :D

And in the last two weeks, we've gone from "no other 001 proposals are real" to "this 001 proposal isn't real" to "yeah, a few 001s are real and a few are fake, whaddaya gonna do?" This was great, though. The thing about the format screw is you're injecting narrative into and around otherwise normal containment procedures, et. al., thus reinforcing the idea that everything is narrative. And yeah, it's convoluted, but it's damn good. Well done. :D

I'm a little on the fence about the proposal referencing other 001's like Swann's and Clef's, I figured if you do it well enough, you can make it work.

item.title: 100 Articles. 001 proposal. S & C Plastics Tale.
item.content:encoded:
A few random, disjointed thoughts:

The intended title for this is "Story of Your Life". I would put it up on the 001 page, but apparently it's locked against editing. Yaaaay.

Mood Music: Matchbox 20: Let's See How Far We've Come. Alternatively: Mob Choir: 99

I've had four or five ideas for an 001 proposal since I came onto this site. Among them were:

  • A puzzle box that acted as a source of most of the anomalies
  • An 001 proposal explaining why travelling to alternate universes was a bad idea
  • The literal serpent from the Wanderer's Library

This is the only one that's stuck. It's a combination of a tale from the S & C Plastics canon (which you should seriously read), an 001 proposal about the world being fictional, and is probably one of the longest-winded things I've ever written.

I've written more than 100 articles for this wiki, obviously, but as of this article, I have 100 surviving pages on the wiki, according to SCPper (which counts things such as hub pages and author pages, whereas Jarvis doesn't). I wanted to make my 100th article big… and then y'all went and wrote about four 001 proposals in the space of a week. I know, I'm sick of 'em too. Lemme have this.

A few people have joked about an S & C Plastics 001 in the past. Well, you know what they say: don't let your memes be dreams. Also if I ever say that again, strangle me. The canon was originally started by Djoric, who I shamelessly stole it from and took over like it was a child I snatched from the crib. He doesn't seem to mind, though. But yeah, S & C Plastics 001 proposal. Let's hope it survives.

Thanks to everyone who critted, including but not limited to: stormbreath, multizig, DrChandra, XilasCrowe, monorail, Homeless Heterotroph, Sir Baubius, Rioghail, not_a_seagull, Modern_Erasmus, SeraDomiCher, IAmTheOoga, Bendenewb, The Great Hippo, and Djoric.
